## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests run successfully (or rationale provided)
- [ ] Key paths manually verified

## Documentation and Comments

- [ ] Documentation updated in this same change where behavior changed
- [ ] Public APIs or interfaces are documented
- [ ] New non-obvious logic includes concise, professional comments

## Logging and Troubleshooting

- [ ] Relevant troubleshooting logs were added or validated
- [ ] No secrets or credentials were introduced in logs
- [ ] Incident note added when impact is recurring or high severity

## Prompt Follow-Up

- [ ] Session prompts archived in logs/session-prompts with UTC timestamps
- [ ] Outstanding prompts captured as follow-up tasks
